facts.value: The BA programme in American Studies at Goethe University focuses on the literature, culture, and history of the USA. Literary texts and non-literary cultural productions and media (such as film) as well as historical sources are analyzed and discussed in their various contemporary and historical dimensions. This opens up perspectives on different actors, environments, institutions, as well as cultural phases, social developments, and historical and political decisions – from the colonial period to the 21st century. Students acquire expertise in the intercultural dimensions of American literatures, cultures, and American history and develop an understanding of interdisciplinary perspectives on their subject of study and various theoretical approaches and methods.
